name: Go services
description: Idiomatic Go review focus: errors, concurrency, interfaces, tests.

lenses.hint: PRIMARY: nil deref, wrong error wrap/return, off-by-one slices, context ignored, deferred close order
PRIMARY: data races, waitgroup misuse, channel close, mutex copy, leaking goroutines
table-driven tests for new branches; race detector-friendly; omit only if pure docs
exported API / interface breaks, JSON/protobuf tags, HTTP status contracts
unbounded buffers, O(n^2) on request path, unnecessary allocations (only with evidence)
command injection, path traversal, TLS skip-verify, secret in logs
interface bloat only if it causes real future defect risk

extra_focus: Flag ignored errors (`_ =`) on I/O and unlock paths when they can fail closed incorrectly.
Prefer findings with package path + symbol; cite Go test file gaps when production code changes.
